heroHeadline: Pakistan Army Chief in Tehran as US Reports "Slight Progress" on Peace Deal
heroSubtitle: From Cyrus the Great's Achaemenid Empire (550 BCE) through the 1979 Islamic Revolution to the post-war Islamic Republic under Mojtaba Khamenei — now navigating the most complex peace negotiation in the republic's history, as Hormuz transit tolls and uranium enrichment moratorium length emerge as the two core deal obstacles blocking a US-Iran settlement.
